explanation: Newton's third law says forces come in equal, opposite pairs: when A pushes B, B pushes back on A with the same magnitude in the opposite direction. The two skaters push off and the red and purple arrows are always the same length pointing apart. Yet they don't move identically — each acceleration is a = F/m, so the lighter block speeds away faster. Equal forces, unequal accelerations.
bullets: Action and reaction are equal in size and opposite in direction.
The two forces act on DIFFERENT objects, so they never cancel.
Same force, different mass → lighter object accelerates more (a = F/m).
